definitions.explanation: The state of being familiar with something or comfortable with it.
A person one knows well; a regular customer at a shop or establishment.

examples.japanese: {馴染|なじ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧だ。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{馴染|なじ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I'm not familiar with the new environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{馴染|なじ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This flavor is familiar to Japanese people.
This shop has many regular customers.

examples.japanese: {幼|おさな}{馴染|なじ}み⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met with my childhood friend after a long time.

examples.japanese: {馴染|なじ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I had dinner at my regular restaurant.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {馴染|なじ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ - a familiar shop, regular haunt
- {馴染|なじ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ - regular customer
- {幼|おさな}{馴染|なじ}み - childhood friend (very common term)
- {馴染|なじ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ - to be familiar with
- {馴染|なじ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - to be unfamiliar with

WRITING:
The kanji {馴|な}じむ means "to get used to" or "to become familiar." The word is often written in hiragana as なじみ.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{顔馴染|かおなじ}み→顔馴染み：07305_kaonajimi⟧ - familiar face, acquaintance
- {馴染|な}じむ (verb) - to become familiar, to fit in
